in_hebrew.name: עזלאה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Azaleah is derived from the Hebrew root עזל (azal), meaning 'help' or 'strength'. The name Azaleah, therefore, means 'God is my help' or 'God is my strength'. It is a beautiful name that conveys the idea of dependence on God for support and protection.

in_greek.name: Αζαλέη
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Azaleah does not have a direct translation in Greek. It is believed to be of Hebrew origin and was adopted into the Greek language as a transliteration of the Hebrew name.

in_latin.name: Azalea
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Azalea in Latin is simply the transliteration of the Greek name, as the name did not have a direct translation into Latin from the Hebrew.

biblical_reference.note: The name Azaleah appears in the Hebrew Bible as a place name and a personal name. In Judges 12:15, it is mentioned as the name of a place where the tribe of Ephraim gathered to offer sacrifices. In 1 Samuel 14:3 and 2 Samuel 17:27, it is mentioned as the name of a woman who was a servant of King Saul and later of King David.
